interaction_history.overview: Three detectives in the corrupt and brutal L.A. police force of the 1950s use differing methods to uncover a conspiracy behind the shotgun slayings of the patrons at an all-night diner.
interaction_history.title: L.A. Confidential

interaction_history.overview: Primo & Secondo, two immigrant brothers, pin their hopes on a banquet honoring Louis Prima to save their struggling restaurant.
interaction_history.title: Big Night

interaction_history.overview: A stranger mentors a young Reno gambler who weds a hooker and befriends a vulgar casino regular.
interaction_history.title: Hard 8 (a.k.a. Sydney, a.k.a. Hard Eight)

interaction_history.overview: Glengarry Glen Ross, follows the lives of four unethical Chicago real estate agents who are prepared to go to any lengths (legal or illegal) to unload undesirable real estate on unwilling prospective buyers.
interaction_history.title: Glengarry Glen Ross

interaction_history.overview: The adventures of a heroic and debonair stalwart mouse named Stuart Little with human qualities, who faces some comic misadventures while searching for his lost bird friend and living with a human family as their child.
interaction_history.title: Stuart Little

interaction_history.overview: Two street-wise Chicago cops have to shake off some rust after returning from a Key West vacation to pursue a drug dealer that nearly killed them in the past.
interaction_history.title: Running Scared

interaction_history.overview: After Scott has a fight with his father and runs away and when his father refuses to go after him. His mother, Collette, then goes to one of her former boyfriends, Jack, a lawyer, and tells him that he's her son's real father. Jack initially refuses. So she goes to another boyfriend, Dale, who goes off looking for Scott. Eventually the two men meet and realize that they are looking for the same boy and that Collette told them they are the boy's father. What follows is a mad chase, cause the boy doesn't want to go back.
interaction_history.title: Fathers' Day

interaction_history.overview: Martin Blank is a freelance hitman who starts to develop a conscience, which causes him to muff a couple of routine assignments. On the advice of his secretary and his psychiatrist, he attends his 10th year High School reunion in Grosse Pointe, Michigan.
interaction_history.title: Grosse Pointe Blank

interaction_history.overview: The lives of many individuals connected by the desire for happiness, often from sources usually considered dark or evil.
interaction_history.title: Happiness

interaction_history.overview: Jack Manfred is an aspiring writer who to make ends meet, takes a job as a croupier. Jack remains an observer, knowing that everything in life is a gamble and that gamblers are born to lose. Inevitably, he gets sucked into the world of the casino which takes its toll on his relationships and the novel he is writing.
interaction_history.title: Croupier
